overview_description.description:
Analyzer is building the future of Automated Technical Analysis

A live platform that scans the crypto market 24/7 and turns strategies into clear, explainable opportunities.

CORE PRODUCT

500+ coins + 600 strategies monitored

24/7 scanning across 6 timeframes with 20M+ checks daily

Smart Signals: see bullish/bearish reasons (less emotion, more clarity)

Built-in Education: guides for every signal (beginner-friendly)

No-Code Strategy Builder: create custom strategies without coding

Future AI-Powered Analytics with 180+ technical pattern detection

WEB3 ECOSYSTEM (SUBSCRIPTIONS + REFERRALS)

Web3 Subscriptions & ReferDrop: smart-contract payments + instant commission claims

ReferDrop is live: 30% instant claim to the referrer + 10% discount to the referred user

Decentralized & multi-chain access (wallet-based, no KYC)

TOKEN UTILITY & VALUE ACCRUAL

Buyback & Burn: 10% of annual revenue used to buy back and burn tokens (reduces supply permanently)

Profit Sharing: 10% of annual revenue distributed to token holders + stakers

WHAT’S ALREADY BUILT (MILESTONES)

Live product: automated market scanning + strategy discovery engine

500+ verified assets covered + 600+ pre-built strategies

180+ pre-analyzed technical modules

Multi-chain subscriptions + full wallet-connect infrastructure

Community live (Telegram / Discord / X) + Telegram Mini App + quests/points campaigns

AI Support Agent live (website + Discord)

Listed on Linea Hub

ROADMAP (HIGH LEVEL)

Q1 2026: Presale launch + growth campaigns + expand community ops

Q2 2026: Partnerships + co-marketing + scale content/community programs

Q3 2026: Signal Alerts development + Points System launch

Q4 2026: Backtesting engine

Q1 2027: AI Analyst (technical + fundamental reports)

Q2 2027: Auto-trading via API + Copy-trading platform + ecosystem expansion
